verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI supports non-interactive scripted runs and GitHub Actions-based triggers (PR reviews, issue triage, @mention on-demand assistance) which can approximate scheduled/triggered automation, but there is no evidence of a persistent, self-scheduling 'always-on agent' that autonomously maintains and fixes software over time. missing for 10: native scheduler/cron support, persistent agent daemon or watch-mode, evidence of autonomous multi-cycle maintenance without human triggering, and reliability data (community reports actually describe agent mode getting stuck in loops or failing tasks).
